meta.description: Join Tano. We build AI agents that run influencer marketing end-to-end for global consumer brands. See open engineering and creator roles in London.

hero.title: Careers at Tano
paragraphs: Tano is an AI-native influencer marketing company. We pair human experts with AI agents to run influencer and affiliate campaigns for consumer brands end-to-end. We're a small, fast-growing team in London, working with brands like Hello Fresh, Bloom & Wild and Unilever. We're hiring across engineering and client growth.

items.title: Product Engineer
items.body: Own the agent that runs influencer marketing end-to-end, in production, for paying brands.

items.title: Product Security Engineer
items.body: Our agents talk to tens of thousands of people and spend live brand budgets, with no person in the loop. Own the security of all of it.

items.title: Senior Account Manager, Creator Growth
items.body: Own a portfolio of creator programmes as growth channels in their own right: part strategist, part operator, part account manager, with agentic AI doing the work that used to need a team.
